semantic_fragments.content: U_max was the highest no-load voltage occurring in the circuit under investigation, taking into consideration mains voltage variations as in 4.10. I_max was the highest current flowing in the circuit under investigation, taking into account MAINS VOLTAGE variations as in 4.10. C_max and L_max are values occurring in relevant circuit.

U_max additionally determined with actual resistance R when equivalent resistance R in Fig G.5 was less than 8000. Peak value taken into consideration when a.c. supplied. An equivalent circuit calculated to determine max capacitance, inductance, and U_max and I_max, either as d.c. or a.c. peak values in case of a complicated circuit.

When energy produced in an inductance or capacitance in a circuit is limited by voltage or current-limiting devices, two independent components applied, to obtain the required limitation even when a first fault (short or open circuit) in one of these components. Above requirement not applied to transformers complying with this standard. Above requirement not applied to wire-wound current-limiting resistors provided with a protection against unwinding of the wire in case of rupture.

Compliance verified by examination of CATEGORY APG ME EQUIPMENT, parts, and components, or by temperature measurements made in accordance with 11.1, or by U_max, I_max, R, L_max and C_max determined together with application of Figs G.4-G.6. Alternatively, compliance verified by comparison with design data.

ANNEX L: INSULATED WINDING WIRES FOR USE WITHOUT INTERLEAVED INSULATION. BASIC, SUPPLEMENTARY, DOUBLE, and REINFORCED INSULATION in wound components without interleaved insulation complied with this Annex covering round winding wires between 0.05 mm and 5.00 mm diameters. Wire construction: Overlap of layers when wire is insulated with two or more spirally wrapped layers of tape is adequate to ensure continued overlap during manufacture of wound component. Layers of spirally wrapped wire insulation are sufficiently secured to maintain the overlap.
